A Descriptive Catalogue of the Sanskrit Manuscripts in the Tanjore Maharaja Serfoji’s Sarasvati Mahal Library, Tanjore (Tanjore). Vols. 1–19.

It is noted as kāvya in the 1909 'List of Sanskrit, Jain, and Hindi manuscripts purchased by order of Government and deposited in the Sanskrit College, Benares', p. 3 (ms. 1791). See New Catalogus Catalogorum (NCC). Vols 1–36: vol. 5, p. 14a.
